title: locate
description: Finds the nearest specified biome or structure if it exists in the current dimension. Prints an error if it does not. See more in the [Popular Commands documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/minecraft/creator/documents/commandspopularcommands#locate).

usenewchunksonly.title: useNewChunksOnly
usenewchunksonly.description: A `Boolean` to specify whether to use new chunks only. Default: `false`.
